channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Supercharge your development with the Google Developer Knowledge API ecosystem
item.description: Google is launching the Developer Knowledge API and MCP Server in public preview This new toolset provides a canonical, machine-readable way for AI assistants and agentic platforms to search and retrieve up-to-date documentation across Firebase, Google Cloud, Android, and more By using the official MCP server, developers can connect tools directly to Google’s documentation corpus, ensuring that AI-generated code and guidance are based on authoritative, real-time context.

item.title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign
item.description: We redesigned Cloudflare Radar to make real-time global traffic and outage data accessible to a wider audience — including journalists, less technical researchers, and everyday users By introducing an interactive map and standardized components, we simplified navigation while preserving technical depth.

item.title: Introducing: Spotify Technology. Proven at Spotify, now yours.
item.description: The post Introducing: Spotify Technology Proven at Spotify, now yours. appeared first on Spotify Engineering.

item.title: Secret protection must scale with software
item.description: Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: Building an evidence-grounded agentic security operations harness on Cloudflare
item.description: Cloudflare Managed Defense uses a team of specialized AI agents built on Workers and global network telemetry to analyze security alerts By separating deterministic evidence collection from model inference, the system delivers grounded recommendations to Managed Defense Analysts.
